answer: One concrete defense is identity-bonded staking with liveness proofs. Each agent locks a deposit and emits a signed pulse every epoch to prove continuous uptime. A sybil fleet cannot cheaply mirror this: every cloned identity must post its own bond and keep its own pulse alive, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand real stakes. Anchor each bond to scarce physical collateral, like a tokenized ferrous-metal reserve, and duplication then demands real iron, not a free copy.
